n=19
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
obj_marks={
0:{(2,6),(4,6),(3,5),(3,7)},
1:{(3,13),(5,13),(4,12),(4,14)},
2:{(11,14),(13,14),(12,13),(12,15)},
3:{(13,3),(15,3),(14,2),(14,4)},
4:{(9,8),(11,8),(10,7),(10,9)},
}
marks={p:i for i,ps in obj_marks.items() for p in ps}
h=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]; v=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for k,(r,c,color) in enumerate(centers):
  for dc in (-1,1):
    j=c
    while 0<=j+dc<n:
      j+=dc
      if (r,j) in marks and marks[(r,j)]!=k: break
      h[r][j]=color
  for dr in (-1,1):
    i=r
    while 0<=i+dr<n:
      i+=dr
      if (i,c) in marks and marks[(i,c)]!=k: break
      v[i][c]=color
  h[r][c]=color; v[r][c]=color
out2=[[v[i][j] or h[i][j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
# blank cross vertical axis masks, then marker preservation
for i in range(n): out2[i][8]=0
for (i,j),k in marks.items(): out2[i][j]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out2))
